subject: INZ compute plan — cirrus week + storage
body: Hi Ines, quick note on compute for InfiniteNature-Zero so nothing surprises us in Q3. Dev iterations (softmax-splatting renderer port, StyleGAN2 patch validation) stay on titan-a100 best-effort; we're averaging 24 GPUs there and that's fine. The big item is the retrain: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-07-06 — 128 accelerators — and the full LHQ retrain is scheduled against it. Plan is about ten days of wall-clock packed into that week with checkpointing every 4 hours, so if the pod has any planned interrupts those days please flag now. Separately, can you confirm our storage quota can absorb the LHQ mirror plus checkpoints (~9 TB)? Dmitri is holding a mid-July Launch Review slot, so the retrain week is on the critical path. Thanks, Santiago
